instructions:
1. Sit on the edge of a bench with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
3. Extend your right leg forward until it is straight and parallel to the floor.
4. Hold and feel the stretch along the back of the thigh.
5. Lower the leg, then repeat on the left side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the extended leg straight to target the hamstring fully.
2. Hinge slightly forward at the hips for a deeper stretch.
3. Breathe slowly and do not bounce.
4. Support the thigh with your hands if you cannot hold the leg up.
name: Leg extended stretch on bench

instructions:
1. Sit in the leg press machine and place your feet close together, centred on the platform.
2. Adjust the seat so your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
3. Hold the side handles and press your back into the backrest.
4. Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking the knees.
5. Bend your knees with control to return to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat against the backrest throughout.
2. A close stance shifts emphasis toward the outer quad.
3. Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
4. Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.
name: Leg press machine close stance

instructions:
1. Sit in the leg press machine and place your feet wider than shoulder-width, high on the platform.
2. Point your toes slightly outward and keep your feet flat.
3. Adjust the seat so your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
4. Hold the side handles and press your back into the backrest.
5. Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
6. Bend your knees with control to return, then repeat.
tips:
1. A high, wide stance shifts emphasis to glutes and hamstrings.
2. Push through your heels to drive the hips.
3. Keep your back flat against the backrest throughout.
4. Keep knees tracking over your toes.
name: Leg press wide high stance

instructions:
1. Support your body on a captain's chair, forearms on the pads and back against the rest.
2. Let your legs hang straight down and brace your core.
3. Keep your legs straight and lift them together until parallel to the floor.
4. Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Curl your pelvis up at the top to shift load onto the abs.
2. Move under control and do not swing the legs.
3. Keep shoulders pressed down to stay stable.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Leg raises (straight legs)
